findings.evidence: GitHub reported the repository public and the collector used no token.
findings.limitation: A local fixture declaration does not prove that an equivalent remote repository is public.
findings.title: Public, read-only source boundary

findings.evidence: All 3 observed action reference(s) were pinned to full commit SHAs.
findings.limitation: Pinning reduces tag-mutation risk but does not prove an action or workflow safe.
findings.title: Immutable workflow action references

findings.evidence: A permissions declaration was observed in all 1 workflow file(s).
findings.limitation: Presence is not a semantic least-privilege proof; nested YAML and effective GitHub defaults were not evaluated.
findings.title: Explicit workflow permissions

findings.evidence: Observed 1 path(s) that appear to contain SBOM evidence.
findings.limitation: File naming/presence does not prove completeness, freshness or accuracy.
findings.title: Software-bill-of-materials evidence

findings.limitation: Tests were not executed; result authenticity, coverage and revision association were not verified.
findings.title: Test-result evidence

findings.evidence: Observed licence evidence: files=2, GitHub SPDX=MIT.
findings.limitation: No legal interpretation, dependency-licence compatibility assessment or ownership opinion was performed.
findings.title: Licence declaration

findings.limitation: Presence was observed; signatures, issuer identity and subject-artifact binding were not cryptographically verified.
findings.title: Release provenance or attestation evidence

findings.evidence: No root or .github SECURITY.md was observed.
findings.limitation: Policy presence does not prove response performance or vulnerability handling.
findings.title: Security policy

findings.evidence: Checked 5 relative Markdown link(s); 1 unresolved target(s).
findings.limitation: External URL availability, anchors, rendered-site routing and non-Markdown documentation were not tested.
findings.title: Documentation local-link integrity

findings.evidence: Protection settings were not observable in the bounded public/read-only collection.
findings.title: Default-branch protection

findings.evidence: Public API returned 1 contributor record(s); the largest observed share was 100.0%.
findings.limitation: The API page is capped, bot/anonymous identity may distort results, and concentration is not a continuity verdict.
findings.title: Contributor concentration

cannot_certify: This snapshot cannot certify security, compliance, accessibility, legal fitness, release integrity or operational readiness.
Observed evidence may be incomplete, stale, misleading or unrelated to the deployed product.
A pass means only that the stated bounded observation was made; it is not an assurance opinion or warranty.
not_observed: Default-branch protection was not observable without privileged repository access.
Secrets, private branches, private issues, organisation rulesets and non-public repository settings were outside the public/no-token boundary.
not_tested: Repository code, builds, tests, dependencies and workflows were not executed.
External links, runtime behaviour, exploitability, code quality and production deployment were not tested.
Cryptographic attestation validity and artifact-to-source reproducibility were not verified.
Legal licence compatibility, copyright ownership and regulatory compliance were not assessed.
